snippet.title: [Arknights: Endfield] Beta Test II PV
snippet.description:
"The deeper we venture, the harsher the truths we uncover.
Yet there is no turning back.
The gears of industry in Endfield have begun to turn once more—and a new journey awaits, ready for you to pen its prologue.
Endministrator, guide us... toward the unlit world."

▼//Pre-register on our Official Website https://endfield.gryphline.com

By reaching the Global Pre-Registration Milestones and meeting the required number of official social media followers, you can receive rewards including the 5★ Operator [Snowshine], [Basic HH Permit] ×20, and the 5★ weapon [Finishing Call]!

#ArknightsEndfield #Endfield #EndfieldBetaTestII
